issues: The first-edition printed CHAP CL starts middle of original PDF670/printed636 after separately accepted unnumbered 11th-house friendship introduction, and ends upper PDF671/printed637 before CHAP CLI on pairwise concord.
CL covers the SOURCE-ASSIGNED quality/social classes of associates, as distinct from preceding friend count, actual loyalty, practical support, and later mutual relationship compatibility.

Initial source chooses planets occupying first or eleventh if any, else the rulers of either and potentially an intercepted zodiac sign; no formal arbitration weights for multiple occupied houses or intercepts.

Saturn Jupiter Mars Sun Venus Mercury and Moon each yield very broad lists of alternative friends' historical occupations, classes, appearances, gender and traits; these have no unique calibrated predictive probability.

Saturn categories include poor/trade/stigmatized social occupations, Jupiter legal/clerical/noble, Mars military/surgical and physical-appearance, Sun royal/governmental, Venus art/women/gaming, Mercury scholarly/commercial, Moon matrons/diplomats/water/common people and wavering; none is evidence about actual individuals.

Original says fixed sign at eleventh cusp signals fixed friends, movable a changeable relation and common intermediate constancy, but no time threshold, relationship length or comparator are supplied.

Constancy may also allegedly depend on signs in which significators are placed. One final condition considers eleventh ruler not aspecting its own house OR Venus in her own house. Original conjunction/or scope is preserved without mathematical repair.
The ensuing CHAP CLI on concord is a separate TWO-NATIVITY comparative method. Do not count either birth chart or alleged dyadic harmony from this single-person friend-type chapter.

The source uses period class, gender and moral stereotypes, including allegations of covetousness, pride and inconstancy. No real person sex/gender, honesty, trustworthiness, profession, social status or appearance inference is authorized.
No independent human chart, social network data, occupation labels of friends, matched demographic baseline or prospective test was used. Source statements are NOT human accuracy.
Source method is short photo-anchored historical paraphrase, not glyph-by-glyph diplomatic transcription or full executable chart scorer.
